name: Pastrami
siboNotes: Plain pastrami is naturally FODMAP-free, but check for garlic or onion seasonings in commercial varieties which could trigger SIBO symptoms.
preparationTips: Choose plain pastrami without garlic or onion powder in the seasoning blend
Read labels carefully as some commercial brands add FODMAP-containing spices
Rinse slices if concerned about excess sodium for SIBO management
Serve at room temperature or lightly warmed to aid digestion
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially B12
Good source of iron and zinc
